sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''An Eventful Train Journey'''

Dante visits his sick mentor, [[Metz]], but his condition is getting worse. Later, Lok and Sophie notice he is not himself, even forgetting to wear his socks before leaving for the mission. On a [[Southern Romania Steam Train]], Dante explains to the team that their mission is to infiltrate the castle of the infamous [[Vlad Dracul]] (Vlad the Impaler) who was one of the most evil [[Seekers]] in history. His castle hides a collection of powerful, dark Titans, including the vampiric [[Antedeluvian]] and, because Vlad’s ancient magical spells keep these Titans continuously invoked within the castle, the team must retrieve Vlad's Titan amulets before [[Klaus]] and [[the Organization]] claim them. Meanwhile, Klaus locates the castle using his new power, [[Neverlost]], and promises [[the Professor]] more Titans. 

[[Zhalia]] is grappling with her inner turmoil, secretly haunted by her allegiance to Klaus and her growing bond with the Huntik team. Dante asks if she is okay but she responds by asking him about Metz. The pair move closer, and Dante begins to open up about his feelings for her before they are interrupted by a [[Suit]] attack on the train. The team spring into action and fight off the Suits and their Titans before arriving at the castle. 

'''Entering the Castle'''

Dante uses the [[Spear of Vlad the Impaler]] recovered in their previous mission as a key, and the team enters the castle. Using the [[Holotome]], Dante scans the layout and identifies three main sectors: the main area, tower level, and basements. To cover ground quickly, Dante splits the team up: He will take the upper towers, Zhalia takes the main halls, and Lok, Sophie, and Cherit will explore the dangerous basement levels. Sophie is reluctant as she is suspicious of Zhalia but Dante insists he needs them split in these teams for his plan to work. 

A flashback reveals Zhalia's origins: as a street orphan stealing food, she was recruited by [[Klaus]], who promised her power and status in exchange for acting as a double agent to infiltrate the Huntik Foundation. Zhalia meets with Klaus in the Throne Room and receives her orders to eliminate the team for good. 

'''The Dungeons'''

While searching the subterranean dungeons, Lok and Sophie are attacked by [[Antedeluvian]] who defeats Sophie's [[Icarus]]. Lok notices details on a wall tapestry and uncovers a secret passage in an alcove, allowing him, Sophie and Cherit a means to escape Vlad's Titan oncoming Titan just in time.

Lok and Sophie enter a dungeon area which has a deep pit filled with sharp stakes. Cherit flies down and retrieves a bag from inside a skull; it contains Vlad's Amulets. However, touching the pouch triggers an enchanted skull-shaped trap which flies at them. Zhalia arrives and tells them that the trap hones in on the Seeker carrying the strongest amulets. To protect the group, Lok devises a plan to leave all their Amulets behind under the protection of Cherit and [[Freelancer]], disarming the trap's tracking system. However, taking advantage of Lok having stashed his Amulets away, Zhalia reveals her true colors as an Organization double agent. She disables Lok with an [[Augerfrost]] and locks Cherit in the dungeon. 

Sophie summons [[Sabriel]], revealing she didn't fall for Zhalia's tricks and two engage in a one-on-one battle. Sophie invokes [[Feyone]] and [[Icarus]] while Zhalia summons [[Kilthane]]. As the Titans fight, Zhalia uses her dark Organization powers to overpower Sophie and prepare a final blow with [[Venomhand]]. Desperate to stop her, Lok throws himself in front of Sophie, directly into the line of fire, and taking the hit to save her.

'''Zhalia's Choice'''

Deep in the castle, the genetically enhanced Suits attack Dante, who jumps out onto the tower rooftops summoning [[Caliban]] and [[Solwing]]. As more and more Suits attack, Dante fends them off but he is increasingly outnumbered. Klaus hits him with [[Poisonfang]], knocking him to the ground. As he towers over Dante, Zhalia arrives with Vlad's Amulets, delivering them to Klaus. Satisfied, Klaus orders Zalia to finish off Dante off. A shocked Dante tries to get through to her, which triggers a deep emotional shift in Zhalia. She realizes that unlike Klaus, who viewed her as a tool for power, Lok and Dante genuinely cared for her and trusted her as a true member of their team. Zhalia switches sides and blasts the nearby Suits, giving Dante time to use [[Everfight]] and recover. She takes out the Suits while Dante fights Klaus who invokes [[Brahe]]. Dante responds with [[Metagolem]], and the two giant Titans drag each off the roof into the valley below. Klaus overpowers Dante and tries to finish him but is hit in the back by Zhalia. No longer Klaus' puppet, she invokes [[King Basilisk]] whose petrifying gaze turns Klaus to stone. 

'''Conclusion & Farewell'''

Back at [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], Lok and Sophie are safe - Zhalia wasn't able to go through with it, and instead had tied them up. Although Dante, Lok, Cherit and Sophie fully forgive Zhalia for her betrayal and invite her to stay with the Huntik Foundation, Zhalia expresses deep remorse for her betrayal. Unable to forgive herself and needing find her own way and earn her redemption, she says goodbye to the team and departs into the night. Lok is adamant that Zhalia remains a part of the team and will eventually return one day.

full_text:
Vienna, Austria

Klaus has managed to lay his hands on the powerful Sceptre of Nefertiti, but Dante has put a tracking device on it in order to locate Klaus in his secret base. The Huntik team follows Klaus and sneaks into a bookshop despite the lethal traps disseminated by Klaus. Dante and the Huntik team manage to recover the mythical Spear of Vlad, but Zhalia is in Klaus' hands.

plot_sections.wikitext:
'''An Eventful Train Journey'''

Dante visits his sick mentor, [[Metz]], but his condition is getting worse. Later, Lok and Sophie notice he is not himself, even forgetting to wear his socks before leaving for the mission. On a [[Southern Romania Steam Train]], Dante explains to the team that their mission is to infiltrate the castle of the infamous [[Vlad Dracul]] (Vlad the Impaler) who was one of the most evil [[Seekers]] in history. His castle hides a collection of powerful, dark Titans, including the vampiric [[Antedeluvian]] and, because Vlad’s ancient magical spells keep these Titans continuously invoked within the castle, the team must retrieve Vlad's Titan amulets before [[Klaus]] and [[the Organization]] claim them. Meanwhile, Klaus locates the castle using his new power, [[Neverlost]], and promises [[the Professor]] more Titans. 

[[Zhalia]] is grappling with her inner turmoil, secretly haunted by her allegiance to Klaus and her growing bond with the Huntik team. Dante asks if she is okay but she responds by asking him about Metz. The pair move closer, and Dante begins to open up about his feelings for her before they are interrupted by a [[Suit]] attack on the train. The team spring into action and fight off the Suits and their Titans before arriving at the castle. 

'''Entering the Castle'''

Dante uses the [[Spear of Vlad the Impaler]] recovered in their previous mission as a key, and the team enters the castle. Using the [[Holotome]], Dante scans the layout and identifies three main sectors: the main area, tower level, and basements. To cover ground quickly, Dante splits the team up: He will take the upper towers, Zhalia takes the main halls, and Lok, Sophie, and Cherit will explore the dangerous basement levels. Sophie is reluctant as she is suspicious of Zhalia but Dante insists he needs them split in these teams for his plan to work. 

A flashback reveals Zhalia's origins: as a street orphan stealing food, she was recruited by [[Klaus]], who promised her power and status in exchange for acting as a double agent to infiltrate the Huntik Foundation. Zhalia meets with Klaus in the Throne Room and receives her orders to eliminate the team for good. 

'''The Dungeons'''

While searching the subterranean dungeons, Lok and Sophie are attacked by [[Antedeluvian]] who defeats Sophie's [[Icarus]]. Lok notices details on a wall tapestry and uncovers a secret passage in an alcove, allowing him, Sophie and Cherit a means to escape Vlad's Titan oncoming Titan just in time.

Lok and Sophie enter a dungeon area which has a deep pit filled with sharp stakes. Cherit flies down and retrieves a bag from inside a skull; it contains Vlad's Amulets. However, touching the pouch triggers an enchanted skull-shaped trap which flies at them. Zhalia arrives and tells them that the trap hones in on the Seeker carrying the strongest amulets. To protect the group, Lok devises a plan to leave all their Amulets behind under the protection of Cherit and [[Freelancer]], disarming the trap's tracking system. However, taking advantage of Lok having stashed his Amulets away, Zhalia reveals her true colors as an Organization double agent. She disables Lok with an [[Augerfrost]] and locks Cherit in the dungeon. 

Sophie summons [[Sabriel]], revealing she didn't fall for Zhalia's tricks and two engage in a one-on-one battle. Sophie invokes [[Feyone]] and [[Icarus]] while Zhalia summons [[Kilthane]]. As the Titans fight, Zhalia uses her dark Organization powers to overpower Sophie and prepare a final blow with [[Venomhand]]. Desperate to stop her, Lok throws himself in front of Sophie, directly into the line of fire, and taking the hit to save her.

'''Zhalia's Choice'''

Deep in the castle, the genetically enhanced Suits attack Dante, who jumps out onto the tower rooftops summoning [[Caliban]] and [[Solwing]]. As more and more Suits attack, Dante fends them off but he is increasingly outnumbered. Klaus hits him with [[Poisonfang]], knocking him to the ground. As he towers over Dante, Zhalia arrives with Vlad's Amulets, delivering them to Klaus. Satisfied, Klaus orders Zalia to finish off Dante off. A shocked Dante tries to get through to her, which triggers a deep emotional shift in Zhalia. She realizes that unlike Klaus, who viewed her as a tool for power, Lok and Dante genuinely cared for her and trusted her as a true member of their team. Zhalia switches sides and blasts the nearby Suits, giving Dante time to use [[Everfight]] and recover. She takes out the Suits while Dante fights Klaus who invokes [[Brahe]]. Dante responds with [[Metagolem]], and the two giant Titans drag each off the roof into the valley below. Klaus overpowers Dante and tries to finish him but is hit in the back by Zhalia. No longer Klaus' puppet, she invokes [[King Basilisk]] whose petrifying gaze turns Klaus to stone. 

'''Conclusion & Farewell'''

Back at [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], Lok and Sophie are safe - Zhalia wasn't able to go through with it, and instead had tied them up. Although Dante, Lok, Cherit and Sophie fully forgive Zhalia for her betrayal and invite her to stay with the Huntik Foundation, Zhalia expresses deep remorse for her betrayal. Unable to forgive herself and needing find her own way and earn her redemption, she says goodbye to the team and departs into the night. Lok is adamant that Zhalia remains a part of the team and will eventually return one day.
